description: Use it when the user wants a demo video, a walkthrough, a GIF of a site, or footage of the real site for a video. Records a short demo video of a website: a tour of the pages worth showing, or the steps in a file. The page plays in a browser window on a backdrop, with a visible pointer, smooth scrolling and a zoom on each click; cookie banners and chat bubbles are hidden, never clicked. Saves demo.mp4 (1920x1080, H.264, no sound), demo.gif, poster.png, the picture to show first, and steps.json: each step's start and end, and each click's moment as pressedAt, which music and captions are timed from. A steps file's targets are CSS selectors or text=<words>, and pages and page are for a tour only. A tour gives a page about 4 to 8 seconds. For still screenshots, use take_screenshots instead. The demo-video playbook (makersmcp_playbook) has the whole job. (easyscreenshotkit 0.1.3, on this machine.)

background.description: Behind the window, by default a gradient, dark behind a light site and light behind a dark one: a colour like #0f172a, two or three colours for a gradient, or a .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .avif or .svg picture file.

clean.description: Set to false to keep the banners and bubbles; hide still hides what it names. Otherwise everything fixed on the screen is hidden but a bar along its top and one down a side, so a step that clicks in an app's bottom tab bar needs this false.

fps.description: Frames a second (default 30); steps.json counts its frames at this rate.

frame.description: Set to false for the page alone, filling the video, without the window and the backdrop.

gif.description: Set to false to skip demo.gif, which is made smaller until it is 8 MB at most.

hide.description: CSS selectors of more elements to hide, on top of any under hide in steps.

lang.description: The site's version in this language, when it has one: a language code like de or pt-BR.

out_dir.description: Folder to save into, absolute or relative to /tmp/churn-hnvpfmca. Default: easyscreenshotkit-demo-<host>, where <host> is the site's host without www or the port. A run replaces what an earlier run of this tool left there once it has ended well, and one that fails or is canceled leaves it as it was: give each version its own out_dir. The folder must be empty or hold an earlier run of this tool: any other folder stops it.

page.description: Pages of the same site to take in the tour, like /pricing, or views of a web app by their #route, like /app/#/plants, each taken even past pages. For a tour only.

pages.description: Pages in the tour, the home page included (default 4). A page that scrolls takes about 4 to 8 seconds and one that fits on the screen about 2. The tour starts at the site's root and puts pricing last. For a tour only.

reduced_motion.description: Ask the site for its reduced-motion version.

steps.description: A YAML or JSON file of steps to follow instead of a tour, one action a step: visit, scroll, click, type, key, hover or wait. A target is a CSS selector or text=<words>, and a selector that starts with # goes in quotes. demo.yaml from an earlier tour is one to start from. Not with pages or page.

theme.description: The site's light or dark look (default light).

timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this many seconds (default 900). A tour looks for more pages only while more than 240 seconds are left, so a short one records the home page, url and each page alone, and a step starts while 60 seconds are left, or a quarter of a shorter run's time.

url.description: The website, like https://linear.app. It replaces a steps file's url line and starts a file whose first step is no visit; a visit to a whole address, as every visit in a tour's demo.yaml, still opens that address.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, counted from the start of the call, before returning a job_id to wait on. Some clients end a call after 60 or 240 seconds; 45 is safe in all of them.

zoom.description: How far a click zooms in, 1 to 2.5 (default 1.5). 1 means no zoom. A step in a steps file can set its own.

name: record_demo_video

continued.description: True when this call continued the job an identical call started, instead of starting another.

docs.description: The notes the text shows, and where each one is.

expires_at.description: When the download links stop working.

url.description: Where to download the file, when the job ran on a server.

folder.description: Where the kit saved its files.

last_line.description: What the kit was doing last.

next.description: What to do next, as the Next line says.

passed.description: For checks: whether the check passed.

title: Demo video of a website
